question: In ACL 2023, who are the Tutorial Chairs and Main Conference Chairs?
prompt: In ACL 2023, who are the Tutorial Chairs and Main Conference Chairs?
expected_answer: Tutorial Chairs: Yun-Nung (Vivian) Chen, Margot Mieskes, Siva Reddy; Main Conference Chairs: Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber, Naoaki Okazaki, Anna Rogers
final_answer: The Tutorial Chairs for ACL 2023 are from National Taiwan University (Taiwan) - yvchen@csie.ntu.edu.tw, University of Applied Sciences, Darmstadt (Germany) - margot.mieskes@h-da.de, and McGill University and Mila (Canada) - siva.reddy@mila.quebec. The Main Conference Chairs are from University of Maryland (USA) - jbg@umiacs.umd.edu, Tokyo Institute of Technology (Japan) - okazaki@c.titech.ac.jp, and IT University of Copenhagen (Denmark) - arog@itu.dk.
